title: radius: Read dictionary files with octets length and concat
description:
The FreeRADIUS dictionary files can include an explicit length
for the octets type, to assist with encoding (e.g., determine
how many bytes to pad.) Ignore it when parsing; on decoding we
just take the length indicated in the AVP. (We could record it
and add the invalid length expert info if it's wrong.)

There's also concat keyword not mentioned in the dictionary man
page that is for RFC types similar to EAP-Message. We special
case handle EAP-Message currently; start to support it by parsing it
and adding it to the attribute info. Even with concat not properly
supported for the other types they can still be shown as opaque
bytes with the proper name.

This allows us to uncomment two of the RFC dictionaries.

Ping #15458
